ix_intro: Comments from Instagram, Facebook Pages, Threads (and YouTube when connected) in one place. Filter what still needs an answer, reply after confirming, assign or mark done. Nothing is sent automatically.
ix_refresh_demo: Demo mode: comments come from sample data
ix_keys_hint: Keys: j / k move · e done · r reply
ix_empty_hint: New comments arrive with each sync and every 30 minutes while MetaDash runs, or press "Refresh comments".
ix_pick_hint: Select a comment on the left to see the thread and reply.
ix_hidden_note: This comment is hidden on the platform.
ix_read_only: This is a read-only team workspace: replying, hiding and refreshing are done by the workspace owner.
ix_reply_unavailable: Replying to {platform} comments is not available here.
ix_classify_intro: Unclassified comments are sent to your AI provider in batches of 50 to label them (positive, negative, question, complaint, spam…). Commenter handles are replaced by @user1…; accounts with AI turned off are skipped.
ix_classify_est: ≈ {n} input tokens for the first batch
ix_sla_intro: First response = time from a comment to the account's first reply. Target: {hours} h.
ix_sla_empty: No comments from followers in this period.
ix_set_intro: How the unified inbox measures response time and checks for new comments.
ix_set_poll: Check for new comments in the background
ix_set_poll_hint: While the app or tray runs. A changed interval applies after the app restarts.
ix_set_ai_sentiment: Classify new comments with AI (sentiment, question)
ix_set_ai_sentiment_hint: Uses the AI provider from Settings → AI assistant; only when the assistant is enabled.
ix_notify_setting: New unanswered comments and overdue replies (inbox)
